changes.title: Version 2.3.0: Maine and Mississippi opinions and AI guidance from six more jurisdictions
changes.summary: Fourteen records added, each read at the issuing body on November 16, 2026: six from Maine's Professional Ethics Commission (Opinion #203 of 2011 and five reviews, from 2013 to 2016, of its older advertising, solicitation and firm-name opinions), two Mississippi Bar opinions (No. 267 of 2024 on generative AI and No. 268 of 2025 on answering online reviews) and six AI guidance documents from Alaska, Arizona, Georgia, Illinois, New Hampshire and Rhode Island. Each AI record is coded on the six AI questions. The index now holds 295 records. No existing record changed.

changes.title: Iowa and Louisiana opinions added
changes.summary: 20 opinions and guidance documents added, each read on the issuing body's own site on November 16, 2026: 14 from Iowa (2004 to 2009) and 6 from Louisiana (2005 to 2022, including the Louisiana State Bar Association's 2022 advertising handbook). The index now holds 281 records from 40 states, the District of Columbia and the ABA. No existing record changed.

changes.title: AI guidance for lawyers by jurisdiction added
changes.summary: A new table, ai-guidance.csv, quotes what official AI guidance for lawyers from 31 jurisdictions says on six marketing questions (chatbot disclosure, AI-made ads, AI intake, claims about AI, confidentiality in AI tools and fees): each answer is a verbatim quote with its place in the document, or the date on which the documents listed did not address the question. It also lists 10 jurisdictions with no statewide AI guidance for lawyers in the bar's or court's ethics opinion or guidance index read on November 13, 2026. The opinion records are unchanged.

changes.title: California AI guidance: quote follows the State Bar's current text
changes.summary: The quote in the record for the State Bar of California's Practical Guidance for the Use of Generative Artificial Intelligence in the Practice of Law now begins "Attorneys must not deploy agentic systems", as the guidance on the State Bar's site reads on November 11, 2026. The record's read date is November 11, 2026. Its holding, practical step and coding are the same.

changes.title: New Jersey In re Opinion No. 735: reporter cite removed
changes.summary: The record for In re Opinion No. 735 (decided May 22, 2025) no longer carries a reporter citation; the record identifies the opinion by its docket number A-61/62-19 and decision date.

changes.title: Version 2.0.0
changes.summary: Three opinions added, each read at the issuing bar: Michigan R-25 (2018), Illinois 06-02 (2006, affirmed in 2010) and South Carolina 25-02 (2025). The index now holds 261 records. No existing record changed.
